{"args":["-c","import api, pages, collections
# tuple input, str input
assert api.collect((1,2,3,4),2)==[1,2,3,4]
assert api.collect('abc',2)==['a','b','c']
assert pages.page('abc',1,1)==(['b'],2)
# custom sized sequence
S=collections.deque(range(6))
assert api.collect(S,4)==list(range(6)); assert list(S)==list(range(6))
# duplicate-preserving exactness, multi-round
d=[7,7,8,7,9,7,7,7]
for s in range(1,12): assert api.collect(d,s)==d
# page cursor chain terminates
c=0; n=0
while True:
    rows,c=pages.page(list(range(10)),c,3); n+=len(rows)
    if c is None: break
assert n==10
print('ok2')"],"environment_names":[],"max_output_bytes":1048576,"program":"python3","timeout_seconds":120}
